content:
IncidentBot: AUTO-PAGER -> anomaly: sustained 5xx increase on public-api gateway starting 02:22:10 UTC. Current 5xx=21% (norm ~0.5%). Traces indicate repeated failovers to secondary regions and repeated client retries.

Casey (oncall): I'm on the line. Pull me the traces and top-affected customers.

Jonah: traces show variant 'emerald-q3' was incorrectly labeled as low-latency compatible; smart-routing selected it as a fallback and its concurrency limits caused timeouts. After the first timeout gateway retried and triggered cross-region failover to eu-central, which is getting overwhelmed.

Mei: client libraries spotted with aggressive retry defaults: http-client-js v1.2.0 (fixed in v1.2.3), mobile-sdk v0.8. Notified infra about contacting client owners.

PlatformBot: Auto-scale attempted on eu-central but hit quota and returned 429s from the scaler controller.

Casey (oncall): Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) disable cross-region auto-fallback; 2) reduce gateway retries and add jitter; 3) demote emerald-q3 to fallback-only or mark not compatible; 4) ask CS to notify top affected customers.

Jonah: executing demotion now:
PATCH https://control-plane.internal/models/emerald-q3
{ "attributes": { "smart_routing_compatible": false, "promote_on_fail": false } }
Action taken at 02:24:31 UTC.

Mei: updating gateway retry policy to cap 2 retries with exponential backoff + jitter:
```
rbctl gateway set-retry --max 2 --backoff exponential --jitter true --base-ms 250
```
Applied at 02:25:10 UTC.

Casey (oncall): Disabling auto region-fallback for policy 'prod-smart' now to stop cross-region amplification.
POST https://control-plane.internal/admin/routing/policies/prod-smart/fallback/disable
(approved by ops-lead)
Completed 02:25:42 UTC.

PlatformBot: capacity increase requested for eu-central (+2 gpu nodes), request id: rq-9742. Pending.

Jonah: Observability: after demotion + retry cap, 5xx dropped from 21% -> 8% in ~45s. Still above baseline; queued retries are draining.

Mei: quick log snippet showing amplification pattern:
```
[02:22:15] gateway: req=tx-789 selected=emerald-q3 region=us-east
[02:22:16] emerald-q3: delayed processing -> 1400ms -> timeout
[02:22:16] gateway: client retry scheduled (no jitter) -> immediate retry
[02:22:16] gateway: failover to eu-central
[02:22:17] eu-central: queue depth +135 -> 429
[02:22:17] client retries -> inflight x2 -> queue depth +270
```
This is the thundering herd.

CS Team: please gather top affected customers for comms.

Support: pulling data -> top impacted last 15m: skyward (11.4k failed reqs), nexio (5.2k), demo-shop (2.7k). Primarily v1/chat streaming endpoints.

Casey (oncall): Approving short-term capacity bump for eu-central while we stabilize. Platform, please apply +2 nodes now.

PlatformBot: capacity bump applied at 02:28:00 UTC, nodes added. Queue depth dropping.

Jonah: Additional mitigation: add a per-variant circuit breaker so that if a variant returns >12% 5xx in 60s it is soft-disabled from routing for 2 minutes. Will file ticket and push temporary rule.

Casey (oncall): Implementing temporary circuit-breaker rule now in control-plane to avoid re-selection of emerald-q3.

PlatformBot: circuit-breaker rule applied at 02:29:12 UTC.

Mei: metrics update: tail token latency peaked at 2.6s; after mitigations tail latency decreased to ~0.3s; 5xx at 3.1% now.

Support: drafting customer notices for skyward and nexio with incident summary and mitigation timeline.

Jonah: Note: some clients have no jitter in retries which amplified the issue. We'll reach out to owners and publish client best practice doc emphasizing exponential backoff + full jitter.

Casey (oncall): Severity change: P0 -> P1 at 02:35:00 UTC. Continue monitoring; keep channel open for postmortem.

Mei: quick follow-up: we should add an onboarding test that runs a synthetic low-concurrency probe against new variants and verifies they can handle N concurrent requests before being marked compatible. Filing onboarding-test ticket.

Jonah: Also recommend a short cooldown window (90s) after any fallback event before allowing another cross-region failover to prevent loops.

PlatformBot: incident channel created #incident-2177770000. Postmortem meeting scheduled.

Casey (oncall): Final note at 02:50: 5xx stabilized ~0.6%, capacity holding, queued retries drained. Leaving channel open for one hour for follow-up. I'll produce draft incident summary with timeline and action items. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
